name: Scribe
description: Transcribe Gmail voicemail attachments into a Google Sheet

MAILBOX_ADDRESS.description: Gmail inbox that receives forwarded voicemail.

GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID.description: OAuth desktop client id from the Cloud project.

GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET.description: OAuth desktop client secret. Do not commit it.

GOOGLE_REFRESH_TOKEN.description: Refresh token printed by scribe-login on a laptop. Do not commit it.

GOOGLE_SHEET_ID.description: Spreadsheet id from the sheet URL, the segment after /d/.

GOOGLE_SHEET_TAB.description: Sheet tab name. A single token with no spaces.

GMAIL_LABEL.description: Label applied after a message is written or permanently skipped.

GROQ_API_KEY.description: Groq API key used for whisper-large-v3-turbo.

WEBHOOK_SECRET.description: HMAC secret shared with Apps Script. Copy it with heroku config:get WEBHOOK_SECRET.

LOCAL_WHISPER_ENABLED.description: Leave false on a Basic dyno. The local extra is not installed on Heroku.
